summary: A two-part synthesizer firmware that plays both parts dual mono, in stereo or layered, with a MORPH fader that glides each sound between two versions.
features: DUEL, STEREO and LAYER modes; layer has velocity crossfade and split
MORPH between a sound and a randomized second version
Ten engines including FM6 and WAVE with user wavetables
Twin filter, sub oscillator and per-part effects, EQ and ducker
128 patches and 15 factory multis; web editor with backup
MIDI channel per part, CC map, MIDI Learn and clock in

headings: usb, the editor and the backup
